topic: The Brachistochrone Problem: The Race of Curves

sections.title: Introduction: The Fastest Path
lecture_lines: Brachistochrone means shortest time in Greek.
Bead slides from A to B under gravity.
Which path shape minimizes travel time?

lecture_lines: Conservation of energy converts potential to kinetic.

sections.title: The Mathematical Framework: Snell's Law Analogy
lecture_lines: Snell's Law describes light refraction paths.
Fermat's Principle seeks the path of least time.
Gravity creates layers of increasing speed.

sections.title: The Solution: The Cycloid
lecture_lines: The optimal curve is a cycloid.
It traces a rolling circle's rim point.
Cycloids balance path length and speed gains.

sections.title: Conclusion: The Tautochrone Connection
lecture_lines: Tautochrone: same time from any start.
The cycloid is nature's fastest path.
